dialogue.origin: （２１時～宜しくお願い致します）
dialogue.content: (I'll be ready from 9 PM. Thank you in advance.)

dialogue.origin: （こちらこそ宜しくお願い致します）
dialogue.content: (Likewise, thank you in advance.)

dialogue.origin: こんにちは相談員です本日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for being here today.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: はい、よろしくお願いします。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 毎日しんどくて死にたいって思います
dialogue.content: Every day feels so tough, and I think about wanting to die.

dialogue.origin: 今、それぐらいつらいお気持ちなんですね。毎日どんな感じなのか、お話お聞かせください。
dialogue.content: It sounds like things are that painful for you right now. Could you tell me what your days are like?

dialogue.origin: 3歳の娘が言うことを聞いてくれません
dialogue.content: My 3-year-old daughter doesn't listen to me.

dialogue.origin: 注意すると閑寂をおこしてしまう
dialogue.content: When I correct her, she throws a tantrum.

dialogue.origin: 癇癪を起こしてしまう
dialogue.content: She throws a tantrum.

dialogue.origin: なるほどですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: もうどうしたらいいかわからない私には子育てなんて無理なんです
dialogue.content: I don't know what to do anymore. I'm just not cut out for raising a child.

dialogue.origin: 娘さんがいらっしゃるんですね。お話お聴きしますね。お子さんはお一人ですか？
dialogue.content: So you have a daughter. I'm here to listen. Is she your only child?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 誰も解ったくれないし、助けてもくれない
dialogue.content: No one understands or helps me.

dialogue.origin: もう死にたい
dialogue.content: I just want to die.

dialogue.origin: そういう気持ち・・・とても辛そうですね・・・
dialogue.content: Those feelings... that sounds so painful.

dialogue.origin: 差し支えなければ、相談者さまを何てお呼びしたらよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: If you don't mind me asking, what should I call you?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: ミキでいいです
dialogue.content: You can call me Miki.

dialogue.origin: ミキさん、有難うございます。ご家族構成も教えて頂いて宜しいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you, Miki. Would you mind telling me about your family?

dialogue.origin: 半年前に夫と離婚させられて、今は実家にいます
dialogue.content: I was forced to divorce my husband six months ago, and now I'm living at my parents' house.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、そういう事もあったのですね。実家には、どなたとお暮しですか？
dialogue.content: I see, so that's what happened. Who do you live with at your parents' house?

dialogue.origin: 両親と、娘とで4人ですんでいます
dialogue.content: It's the four of us: my parents, my daughter, and me.

dialogue.origin: はい、有難うございます。夫さんと、離婚させられて・・・とは、どんな状況だったのか、お聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.content: Okay, thank you. You mentioned you were "made to divorce" your husband... could you tell me more about that situation?

dialogue.origin: 私が悪いんです
dialogue.content: It's my fault.

dialogue.origin: ええ（聞いてます）
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm (I'm listening).

dialogue.origin: どんなことがあったのですか？
dialogue.content: What happened?

dialogue.origin: 双極性障害で、躁状態のときは、買物とか手当たり次第してしまうし、人にもきつく当ってしまいます
dialogue.content: I have bipolar disorder, and during manic episodes, I go on shopping sprees and lash out at people.

dialogue.origin: 鬱のときは家事もおぼつかなくなる
dialogue.content: During depressive episodes, I can barely manage the housework.

dialogue.origin: それは、お辛い思いをされてらっしゃるんですね・・・
dialogue.content: That must be very difficult for you...

dialogue.origin: 姑から酷く責められて、最初は夫は庇ってくれましたが、
dialogue.content: I was harshly blamed by my mother-in-law, and at first my husband defended me, but...

dialogue.origin: ついに夫にも呆れられてしまい、去年の秋に離婚させられてしまったんです
dialogue.content: Eventually, my husband got fed up with me too, and I was forced to divorce him last fall.

dialogue.origin: みんな私が悪いんです
dialogue.content: It's all my fault.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、病気なのに・・・やりきれないですね・・・
dialogue.content: I see... even though it's an illness... that must be unbearable.

dialogue.origin: 仕方ありません
dialogue.content: It can't be helped.

dialogue.origin: お体は今もお辛いですか？
dialogue.content: Are you still feeling unwell physically?

dialogue.origin: 私がこんなだから周りも不幸になる
dialogue.content: Because I'm like this, I make everyone around me unhappy.

dialogue.origin: とても苦しいですね・・・
dialogue.content: That sounds very painful...

dialogue.origin: 頭痛もしますし、パニック障害で呼吸が苦しくなることもあります
dialogue.content: I also have headaches, and sometimes I have trouble breathing due to panic attacks.

dialogue.origin: そんな状態にもあるのですね・・・病院には行かれてますか？
dialogue.content: So you're experiencing that as well... Are you seeing a doctor?

dialogue.origin: 以前は行ってましたが、この頃は病院に行くのもしんどくて行ってません
dialogue.content: I used to go, but lately it's been too much of a struggle, so I haven't been going.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、それほどまで辛い状態なのですね。主治医の先生からは何て言われてますか？
dialogue.content: I see, so that's how difficult it is for you. What has your primary doctor told you?

dialogue.origin: 治らないけど、薬を飲むように言われてました
dialogue.content: They said it won't be cured, but that I should take my medication.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、薬は継続されてますか？
dialogue.content: I see. Are you continuing to take your medication?

dialogue.origin: あまり効いていると思えないので飲んでいません
dialogue.content: I don't feel like it's working very well, so I'm not taking it.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: いろいろとお話お聞きし、とても過酷な状況にいらっしゃるのが伝わってきます。その上に、
dialogue.content: From everything you've shared, I can tell you're in a very harsh situation. On top of that,

dialogue.origin: お体が病気で大変な時に、３歳の娘さんの子育ても、大変な状態ですよね
dialogue.content: while you're struggling with your illness, raising a 3-year-old daughter must also be very difficult.

dialogue.origin: はいもう育てる自信がないんです
dialogue.content: Yes, I don't have any confidence in raising her anymore.

dialogue.origin: そんな気持ちにもなっちゃうんですね・・・
dialogue.content: It's understandable to feel that way...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 苦しいですね・・・
dialogue.content: It's so hard, isn't it...

dialogue.origin: 死にたくなります
dialogue.content: It makes me want to die.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 両親は表だって文句を言ってはきませんが、影では姉に愚痴をこぼしているようです
dialogue.content: My parents don't openly complain to me, but it seems they vent to my older sister behind my back.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、ご両親がですか・・・
dialogue.content: I see... your parents...

dialogue.origin: 私が転がりこんで迷惑なんだと思う
dialogue.content: I think I'm a burden for crashing at their place.

dialogue.origin: 何か直接言われたりしてるんですか？
dialogue.content: Have they said anything to you directly?

dialogue.origin: 直接はいわれませんが、私が困っていても手伝ってはくれません
dialogue.content: Not directly, but they won't help me even when I'm struggling.

dialogue.origin: 誰も解ってくれないでも私が
dialogue.content: No one understands, but...

dialogue.origin: 悪いんです
dialogue.content: ...it's my fault.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・例えば、ご両親とどんな事がありましたか？
dialogue.content: I see... For example, what kinds of things have happened with your parents?

dialogue.origin: 食事のとき以外はあまり話をしません
dialogue.content: We don't talk much, except at mealtimes.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、、以前からそうなのでしょうか？？
dialogue.content: I see. Has it always been like that?

dialogue.origin: 大分前から、あまり話さなくなりました私が面倒ばかりかけてきたから、嫌になったのかも知れません
dialogue.content: We haven't talked much for a long time. Maybe they got tired of me because I've been nothing but trouble.

dialogue.origin: そうですか・・・面倒とは、ご病気のことですか？
dialogue.content: I see... By 'trouble,' do you mean because of your illness?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: でも、、ご両親にとって、ミキさんは娘で可愛いと思うと思いますよ、それに孫さんもとても可愛いと思ってると思うのですが・・・どんな感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: But... I'm sure your parents love you as their daughter, and I'd imagine they think their granddaughter is very dear, too... what do you think?

dialogue.origin: うーんそうなのかな
dialogue.content: Hmm, I wonder if that's true.

dialogue.origin: 子どもはあまり好きではなさそうです
dialogue.content: They don't seem to be very fond of children.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね、そう感じることもあったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see, so there have been times you've felt that way.

dialogue.origin: 娘は癇癪持ちだし
dialogue.content: My daughter is prone to tantrums.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、娘さんのこと、もう少しお聞かせください。
dialogue.content: I see... Could you tell me a bit more about your daughter?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: ３才ですと、元気に走りまわったりしてるのですか？
dialogue.content: At three years old, does she run around energetically?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 元気があっていいですね！
dialogue.content: That's great that she's so energetic!

dialogue.origin: おもちゃを散らかしたまま放置したり、荷物の上に登っ危ない事をしたり目が離せません
dialogue.content: She leaves her toys scattered everywhere, climbs on top of things, and does dangerous stuff. I can't take my eyes off her.

dialogue.origin: いくら言っても聞かないし
dialogue.content: No matter how much I tell her, she doesn't listen.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、少しやんちゃな感じでしょうか
dialogue.content: I see... she sounds a bit mischievous.

dialogue.origin: そうですね私がイライラしていて叱るからかもしれませんが
dialogue.content: I guess so. But maybe it's because I get irritated and scold her.

dialogue.origin: ミキさんも病気な上に、お子さんが元気すぎると、イライラもしちゃいますよね
dialogue.content: With your illness, and on top of that your child being so energetic, it's natural to get irritated, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: そんなとき、ご両親はどうですか？
dialogue.content: How are your parents at times like that?

dialogue.origin: 他の部屋にいて知らん顔してます
dialogue.content: They're in another room, pretending not to notice.

dialogue.origin: だれも助けてくれない
dialogue.content: No one helps me.

dialogue.origin: でも私がこんなだからみんな私が悪いんです
dialogue.content: But it's because I'm like this. It's all my fault.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですか、、そんな感じなのですね・・・ご両親はどんな心境なのでしょうね？
dialogue.content: I see, so that's how it feels... I wonder what your parents might be feeling.

dialogue.origin: はっきりは言いませんが、私が子連れで戻ってきて、迷惑だとおもっているんだと思います
dialogue.content: They don't say it outright, but I think they feel I'm a nuisance for coming back with a child.

dialogue.origin: 出てけともいえなくて我慢してる
dialogue.content: They can't tell me to leave, so they're just putting up with it.

dialogue.origin: きっとそうだと思います
dialogue.content: I'm sure that's it.

dialogue.origin: 私なんかいない方がいいんです
dialogue.content: It would be better if I weren't here.

dialogue.origin: 今までの人生でいいことなんて無かった
dialogue.content: Nothing good has ever happened in my life.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですか・・・そう思われる何かがあるのですね。
dialogue.content: I see... There must be something that makes you feel that way.

dialogue.origin: 何でもお話ください！ここでは感情も吐き出していいんですよ。
dialogue.content: Please, tell me anything. It's okay to vent your emotions here.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 病気、離婚、ご両親とのこと、子育て、他にはどおですか
dialogue.content: Your illness, the divorce, your relationship with your parents, parenting—what else comes to mind?

dialogue.origin: 結婚生活も辛いことばかりだったし
dialogue.content: My married life was just one painful thing after another, too.

dialogue.origin: ええ（お聴きしてます）
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm (I'm listening).

dialogue.origin: 姑としょっちゅう喧嘩してた
dialogue.content: I was always fighting with my mother-in-law.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 子どもができたときだけは喜んでくれたけれど
dialogue.content: The only time she was happy for me was when I had my child, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: すぐに子どもの育て方が悪いとかでぶつかったりして
dialogue.content: Soon after, we started clashing over things like how I was raising my child.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 結婚生活のいい思い出なんて何にもない
dialogue.content: I have no good memories of my married life.

dialogue.origin: やりきれないですね・・・
dialogue.content: That must be so hard to bear...

dialogue.origin: 夫さんとはいかがでしたか？
dialogue.content: How was it with your husband?

dialogue.origin: どうだったのかな？
dialogue.content: I wonder how it was.

dialogue.origin: いまは夫さんへのお気持ちいかがですか？
dialogue.content: How do you feel about your ex-husband now?

dialogue.origin: 好きだって思ったこともあたのかもしれないけど楽しかったことなんで何にも思い出せない
dialogue.content: I might have thought I loved him at some point, but I can't remember a single happy moment.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: いろいろとお話お聞かせ頂き有難うございました。ここまで、少し纏めさせて頂いて宜しいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing so much with me. Would it be alright if I summarize what we've talked about so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ミキさんはご自身も病気をお持ちで、その上に子育ても大変、でも
dialogue.content: Miki, you have your own illness, and on top of that, parenting is very difficult, and yet,

dialogue.origin: ご両親は協力して頂けない。離婚した姑さんとも意思疎通ができず、大変な思いをされてきた。夫さんとも上手くいかなかった。
dialogue.content: your parents aren't cooperative. You couldn't communicate well with your former mother-in-law and had a very hard time. Things didn't go well with your husband either.

dialogue.origin: ミキさんこれまでとてもお辛い思いをされてきたんだと思います。そこで、
dialogue.content: I believe you've been through a great deal of pain, Miki. With that in mind,

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: まず一つは、ミキさん自身の病気が心配です。まずは、大変かもしれませんが、通院されることをお勧めします。
dialogue.content: First of all, I'm concerned about your illness. I know it may be difficult, but I recommend that you resume your visits to the doctor.

dialogue.origin: それと、
dialogue.content: Also,

dialogue.origin: 本当はご両親に子育てを協力いただけるといいと思うのですが、
dialogue.content: Ideally, it would be great if your parents could help with raising your daughter, but...

dialogue.origin: 一度お姉さまにご相談されるとかはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: how about consulting your older sister?

dialogue.origin: 姉には嫌みを言われているので無理です
dialogue.content: My sister makes snide remarks to me, so that's impossible.

dialogue.origin: のこのこ戻ってきて親に迷惑かけてって
dialogue.content: She says things like, "You came crawling back and are just a burden on our parents."

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・どなたか、協力いただける方はおりますか？
dialogue.content: I see... Is there anyone at all who could help you?

dialogue.origin: 誰もいないから相談にきたんです
dialogue.content: I came for counseling because there's no one.

dialogue.origin: あっ、ごめんなさい。相談というか、子育てとか、ミキさんの体調が大変な時に助けをお願いできる関係の方、いらっしゃいませんか？
dialogue.content: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't mean for counseling, but rather, is there anyone in your life you could ask for help with childcare or for support when you're not feeling well?

dialogue.origin: うーん
dialogue.content: Umm...

dialogue.origin: 思い当たりません
dialogue.content: I can't think of anyone.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、、ではやはりご両親とじっくり話し合われみるのはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see... In that case, how about trying to have a thorough discussion with your parents?

dialogue.origin: どうなのかな
dialogue.content: I'm not sure about that.

dialogue.origin: 今のままでは、ずーっと大変かと思います
dialogue.content: If things stay as they are, I think it will continue to be very difficult for you.

dialogue.origin: 解決にはならないかもしれませんが、大変な状況を話あってみるのがいいかと思いますが。身内ですし。
dialogue.content: It might not solve everything, but I think it would be good to try talking about your difficult situation. They are your family, after all.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 有難うございました。また、お話おきかせください。何か進展あるといいのですが。
dialogue.content: Thank you. Please feel free to talk with me again anytime. I hope things improve for you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今日はお話を聴いてくださりありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you for listening to me today.

dialogue.origin: 本日は相談に来てくださり有難うございました。また、いつでもお越しください。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming for counseling today. Please feel free to come back anytime.

dialogue.origin: またよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: I will. Thank you again.

dialogue.origin: 本日はありがとうございｍした。
dialogue.content: Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.origin: （有難うございました。お疲れさまでした）
dialogue.content: (Thank you very much. Thank you for your time.)

dialogue.origin: （お疲れさまでした。ありがとうございました。勉強になりました。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your time. Thank you very much. I learned a lot.)

dialogue.origin: （それでは終了させていただきます）
dialogue.content: (Then I will end the session now.)

dialogue.origin: （了解しました）
dialogue.content: (Understood.)

topic.sub: 両親とのコミュニケーション不足
